correctness.rationale: The one-line cubic has no line through P=[0:1:0:0], giving one global affine Grassmann chart. Restricting the cubic yields a²+c³=0, 2ab+3c²d=0, b²+a+3cd²=0, b+d³=0; eliminating a,b without denominators gives f=c³+9c²d⁴+6cd⁸+d¹² and g=3c²d+6cd⁵+2d⁹. Dehomogenizing with c/d⁴ yields cubic F and quadratic G with exact resultant -1. Thus no nonorigin point in any geometric fiber; degree12/9 weighted regular sequence gives length27, Hilbert series (1-s⁹)(1-s¹²)/((1-s)(1-s⁴)), socle16, embedding dimension2. Proper and affine implies finite; equal fiber lengths imply Z-torsion free and free rank27. Mod3 gives precisely (c³,d⁹). No step divides by a prime. Finite line-enumeration checks are corroboration, not proof.
